_comment: Maps SPDX license identifiers (as returned by GitHub's license.spdx_id) to a commercial_use flag. This is a heuristic operational policy, NOT legal advice. GPL/AGPL/LGPL permit commercial use (they impose copyleft/distribution obligations, not a commercial-use ban) so they map to 1. Source-available licenses that explicitly restrict competing commercial/hosted use map to 0. Anything not listed falls back to `default_unknown` and is routed to manual review rather than guessed.
